title: Google DeepMind Disbands Its Nobel-Prize Winning AlphaFold Team
excerpt: DeepMind's award-winning AlphaFold team is no more.
content_html:
It has already reassigned some members of the DeepMind project, while others have already left the company.

Google

The award-winning team behind Google DeepMind's AlphaFold program is no more, according to Financial Times. Google has reassigned some of the team's key members and the original authors of its papers to both Gemini-related projects and scientific research endeavors, while a few others have already left the company.

AlphaFold is an AI program that can accurately predict three-dimensional structures of proteins from their amino acid sequences in minutes instead of years. It's now being used to accelerate drug discovery, develop vaccines and understand the structural changes in proteins associated with neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's.

DeepMind started developing AlphaFold in 2018. In 2020, it was recognized as a solution to humanity's 50-year-old "protein folding problem," which sought to answer how amino acids automatically fold into complex 3D shapes. Those shapes determine the biological role of a protein. Scientists had identified the structures of roughly 170,000 proteins over the past 50 years, using tools and techniques like X-ray and nuclear magnetic resonance. The AlphaFold team took information from those previous work and then fed it to their AI to train AlphaFold. 

In 2021, Nature published the papers with AlphaFold's methodology and the structure predictions of the entire human proteome, or the complete set of proteins expressed by our species. DeepMind then launched the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database, giving researchers free access to over 200 million protein structure predictions. In 2024, DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis and John Jumper, who was a staff research scientist when the project began and who eventually became a VP and engineering fellow, won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their work on AlphaFold. 

Jumper announced in June that he was leaving DeepMind to join Anthropic. A couple of his colleagues jumped ship to Anthropic, as well. DeepMind has confirmed to the Times that it also moved staff members internally to Gemini-focused projects. Other former staff members were reassigned to Alphabet's drug-discovery company Isomorphic Labs, which is a DeepMind spin-off.

As the Times notes, this represents Google's decision to put more and more of its resources into developing Gemini. "Our strategy over the last nine years has been to focus on grand challenges... a concrete goal every project is focused on," said Pushmeet Kohli, the VP of research at Google DeepMind. "The strategy has evolved."

"We are incredibly proud of our scientific heritage and the global impact of AlphaFold, which inspired the launch of Isomorphic Labs with the mission to reimagine drug discovery," DeepMind spokesperson has told us. "Many of the researchers behind AlphaFold continue today to drive scientific and technological advances across Google, Google DeepMind, and Isomorphic Labs."

Update 07/30/26 6:13AM ET: We updated this post to change the headline to better reflect the news and to add DeepMind's statement.

content_html_zh:
它已经重新分配了 DeepMind 项目的一些成员，而其他人则已经离开了公司。

谷歌

据英国《金融时报》报道，谷歌 DeepMind AlphaFold 项目背后的获奖团队已不复存在。 谷歌已将团队的一些关键成员和论文的原始作者重新分配到与双子座相关的项目和科学研究工作中，而其他一些人已经离开了公司。

AlphaFold 是一个人工智能程序，可以在几分钟而不是几年内根据氨基酸序列准确预测蛋白质的三维结构。 它现在被用来加速药物发现、开发疫苗以及了解与阿尔茨海默氏症和帕金森氏症等神经退行性疾病相关的蛋白质的结构变化。

DeepMind 于 2018 年开始开发 AlphaFold。 2020 年，它被认为是人类 50 年来“蛋白质折叠问题”的解决方案，该问题试图解答氨基酸如何自动折叠成复杂的 3D 形状。 这些形状决定了蛋白质的生物学作用。 过去 50 年来，科学家利用 X 射线和核磁共振等工具和技术鉴定了大约 170,000 种蛋白质的结构。 AlphaFold 团队从之前的工作中获取信息，然后将其输入到他们的人工智能中来训练 AlphaFold。

2021年，《Nature》杂志发表了利用AlphaFold的方法论以及整个人类蛋白质组或我们物种表达的完整蛋白质集的结构预测的论文。 DeepMind 随后推出了 AlphaFold 蛋白质结构数据库，让研究人员可以免费访问超过 2 亿个蛋白质结构预测。 2024 年，DeepMind 首席执行官 Demis Hassabis 和 John Jumper（该项目开始时是一名研究科学家，最终成为副总裁兼工程研究员）因在 AlphaFold 上的工作而获得了诺贝尔化学奖。

Jumper 在 6 月份宣布他将离开 DeepMind 加入 Anthropic。 他的几位同事也跳槽到了 Anthropic。 DeepMind 已向《纽约时报》证实，它还将内部员工转移到以 Gemini 为重点的项目中。 其他前员工被重新分配到 Alphabet 的药物发现公司 Isomorphic Labs，该公司是 DeepMind 的衍生公司。

正如《泰晤士报》所指出的，这代表着谷歌决定投入越来越多的资源来开发 Gemini。 “过去九年我们的战略是专注于重大挑战...... 每个项目都关注的具体目标，”Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 Pushmeet Kohli 说道。 “战略已经发展。”

DeepMind 发言人告诉我们：“我们对我们的科学遗产和 AlphaFold 的全球影响感到无比自豪，这激发了 Isomorphic Labs 的成立，其使命是重新构想药物发现。” “AlphaFold 背后的许多研究人员如今仍在继续推动 Google、Google DeepMind 和 Isomorphic Labs 的科学技术进步。”
